data.one_liner: Flutter port of the shadcn/ui design system with customizable components.
data.what_it_does: Brings the shadcn/ui design system into Flutter apps with a suite of highly customizable widgets. It provides pre-built implementations of components like accordions, dialogs, forms, selects, and context menus. It replaces or supplements standard UI frameworks with a unified modern design language.
use_when: You want a sleek, modern web-like UI design system in Flutter matching shadcn/ui styling.
You need a comprehensive set of accessible, customizable components including form controls, pickers, and overlays.
You are building desktop or web Flutter applications where traditional Material/Cupertino styles feel out of place.
avoid_when: You want strictly native Material 3 or Cupertino aesthetics without custom styling overhead.
Your project cannot adopt modern Flutter versions (requires Flutter 3.47+ due to migration to standalone material_ui/cupertino_ui).
strengths: Extensive collection of completed components covering buttons, dialogs, forms, tables, and menus.
High level of widget customizability and theming capabilities.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Recent versions require Flutter 3.47+ and breaking migration to standalone material_ui and cupertino_ui packages.
Several components from the standard shadcn/ui spec remain unimplemented (e.g., carousel, collapsible, command, drawer).
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47+ and requires migrating imports away from standard flutter/material.dart to material_ui, with potential need for MaterialUiCompatibilityBridge for older dependencies.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick material_ui if you want Google's standard Material Design widgets instead of the shadcn/ui look.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick cupertino_ui if your goal is an authentic, native iOS look and feel.
